title: Thelgen Rock
wikitext:
[[Image:Thelgen Rock.jpg|thumb|Thelgen Rock]]
[[Thelgen Rock]] is an area in the southern [[Wetlands]] that is crawling with poisonous spiders. The name refers to an extensive cavern that stretches deep into the [[Khaz Mountains]]. The caves hold deposits of a rare ore that miners sometimes come to dig up. Frustrated cartographers can also be seen roaming the area trying in vain to explore the last piece of their maps.
